entry.title: New: Resolution 517 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 517-26, Draft 2; adopts GOEAC-120 - 05/05/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAI‘I, BIG ISLAND INVASIVE SPECIES COMMITTEE, FOR THE PURPOSE OF AWARDING GRANT FUNDS TO CONTROL AND COMBAT THE SPREAD OF INVASIVE SPECIES

Funds in the amount of $250,000 from the Department of Research and Development would be used to support critical invasive species efforts.
